name: Static Israeli transportation data
headline: 544,338 trips / 20,100,370 stop_times parsed, 5 tables in Postgres, 10/10 integrity checks pass; licence terms unread (H2)

edge_case_results.detail: HEAD reported Content-Length 3382 (text/html; charset=utf-8); GET delivered 9,557,258 bytes (application/x-zip-compressed). Change detection uses GET + sha256 + zip validation only. Two consecutive GETs of TripIdToDate.zip into an empty directory reported 'new' then 'unchanged'.
230,181 of 20,100,370 stop_times rows are at or past 24:00:00. Largest observed 29:05:59 = 104759s = service day +1d 05:05:59; round trip exact: True.

25 Hebrew names compared byte-for-byte after download -> extract -> parse -> Postgres -> read; 0 mismatches. Coverage: doubled_quote=0, single_quote=0, apostrophe_geresh=6, hebrew_plus_latin=10, hebrew_plus_digits=10, hebrew_latin_digits=5, plain_hebrew=25. Not present anywhere in this feed's stop, route or agency names, so untestable here: doubled_quote, single_quote.

translations.txt parsed: 102,514 rows, schema 'mot-legacy (trans_id/lang/translation)', languages ['AR', 'EN', 'HE']. No sanitisation is applied — the rules would have to be written down first, and nothing in the file required cleaning to parse.

Pairing is decided by trip-id overlap. Primary feed: 246,042 of 246,042 join keys matched (100.0000%) -> ACCEPTED. Comparison feed: 0.0000% -> REJECTED. A deliberately mismatched pair raised FeedPairingError: True.
Both feeds row-counted side by side. 10-day: 892,451 trips / 32,367,255 stop_times. 60-day: 544,338 trips / 20,100,370 stop_times. Only the 60-day feed is loaded (D5).
No dangling references in any counted class.

location_type distribution {'0': 35066, '1': 236}: 236 stations, 1084 stops with a parent (3.1% of all stops). S08 resolves to station 14592 with 9 platforms grouped under it. S01 resolves to 37358 (תל אביב מרכז), which has no platform children; the nearest station to it is 42877 with 3 platforms, 162 m away. Of the 6 rail corpus entries, 0 resolved to a stop with platform children — parent/child grouping in this feed is a bus-terminal construct, not a rail-station model (KDP-011).
Cold run from an empty data directory: started_empty=True, downloaded 195.5 MB, wall time 180.0s, exit status 0, resulting database queryable: True, manual steps: 0.

notes: Primary: israel-public-transportation.zip; TripIdToDate compatibility enforced before load. Service window: ['2026-09-04', '2026-10-04']. 10-day feed is comparison only.
stop_times and shapes are parsed, counted and integrity-checked but deliberately not loaded into Postgres (ADR 0003 / system-design §173).
agency.txt is parsed but not given its own table; agency_name is denormalised onto routes so operator queries work without widening the load set beyond the five tables ADR 0003 names.
usage_terms_confirmed is false and cannot be set by an agent: gov.il returns 403 to automated fetches, so checkpoint H2 needs a human to read and record the licence text.
Cold run: 180.0s from an empty directory to a queryable database, 195 MB downloaded, zero manual steps.
